decision.basis: Reviewed current owned source and all retained/retrieved preimage deltas under the project MIT license; no new upstream source, assets or dependency incorporation was found in this bounded review.

excludes: final wheel/app/SDK distribution composition and notices
scope.independence: This reviewer authored the native policy subset and identifies that prior ownership explicitly. Controller/Window/launcher/UI/exports/SDK deltas were read as another owner's source; this is not claimed to be a wholly independent peer audit of the reviewer's own native implementation.
scope.authorship_limit: Source inspection and retained implementation records support the owned-source recommendation; this is not an exhaustive external source-similarity or authorship warranty.

findings.finding: Native startup DTO/planner, strict Text/pair migration, bounded layout storage and reserved presentation child are original project policy/glue. They reuse private nlohmann/json and native session APIs; no public JSON dependency or new codec/frame implementation was added.

Selected incoming-owner activation extends the existing project Application staging transaction. Window planning/loading/publication and refusal/retry/reset are project-owned orchestration over existing readers and validators; saved workflows/results remain inert data.

ImGui panels, callbacks, diagnostics and compiled bounded observation probe use existing ImGui/internal/std::string APIs and project helpers. No new font, icon, image asset, Java/Fiji source, JAR, model or third-party package is incorporated.

Native/Python registration, public exports, strict constructor path/Boolean conversions, ordinary launcher routing and opaque Python layout compatibility add project glue using existing pybind11/Python/standard-library APIs.

Public SDK Text spelling and startup example use public imagejxx headers and the standard library. Pixel formulas and handcrafted V2 stored-block fixture bytes are owned synthetic test data/wire-format facts, not imported image assets or copied compression-library source.

CMake additions register owned sources/examples and checks using existing imagejxx targets. The reviewed delta adds no find_package, download, vendor source, external link dependency or enabled upstream component.
Desktop session.cpp changes only the stale eager-Z comment to describe already-supported C/Z/T facades; generic native V3 extension framing remains outside this change.

existing_dependencies_reused.change: No new zlib sources/components; existing codec reused.

existing_dependencies_reused.component: Dear ImGui 1.91.9 docking and existing desktop dependencies
existing_dependencies_reused.change: Existing API/header use only; no version/component/assets added.
Existing bindings/runtime scopes; no new package/version.

notice_and_exclusion_requirements: Retain the project MIT copyright/permission notice and all existing notices applicable to components actually shipped.
Non-commercial, research-only, unlicensed/missing-license and unreviewed components remain excluded.
No ImageJ Java source, Fiji plugin source, JARs or pretrained models are brought into this owned-source scope.

Fiji plugin discovery/startup lifecycle, individual plugin eligibility/dependency closures, startup macros/scripts and whole-Fiji commercial/parity gates remain pending or excluded under their existing records.
Qt/PySide remain outside the current native desktop dependency scope; system fonts and platform/compiler runtime obligations are unchanged.

Final source/archive/member/binary identity, actual shipped component notices, product/API/UI acceptance and distribution adoption remain root-owned work. This review does not infer them from source eligibility.

historical_preimages.authorization: Root supplied the exact P06i archive pin and eight exact member names; only those getmember/extractfile results were retained. settings_panel.hpp and ui/__init__.py also match wrapper preimage hashes.

performed: Read source/preimage deltas, local license/notices/dependency records and source identity metadata
